questions.explanation: A two-column grid with clear row rules keeps related handover items aligned without crowding, so night-shift staff can scan faster than with dense or unstructured layouts.

questions.learningObjective: Write a caption for a device photo

options.text: Pump photo
Equipment used on ward three
Staff should check the pump regularly
Infusion pump set at 125 ml per hour at 09:00

questions.explanation: A caption stating rate and time captures the clinically relevant setting, while vague labels or advice do not.

questions.learningObjective: Judge icon-to-text proportion in a handover
questions.stem: Why is an oversized icon beside small text problematic in a handover?

answer.exemplar: An oversized icon draws attention away from the text and creates visual imbalance, making the label harder to read at a glance.

questions.explanation: Oversized icons dominate the line and pull focus from the label, disrupting the intended information hierarchy.

questions.subject: ENGLISH_LANGUAGE
questions.learningObjective: Map colour to meaning in a handover key

stimulus.body: A handover key maps red to urgent, amber to review, and green to stable.

questions.stem: Which colour meaning is most at risk of misinterpretation in this key?

options.text: Amber for review, since amber means caution
Green for stable, since green means go
Red for urgent, since red can mean stop in traffic
All three, since colour coding is always unreliable

questions.explanation: Red for urgent can be misread as stop or danger in other contexts, so its meaning must be defined explicitly in the key.

questions.learningObjective: Correct type size for a handover warning

stimulus.body: A handover allergy warning is the same size as body text.

options.text: Keep the same size and add colour only
Match the warning to footnote size

questions.explanation: Increasing the warning text above body size gives it prominence, while same or smaller sizes fail to signal importance.
questions.hint: Make the warning larger than body.

questions.learningObjective: Scale a handover barcode for scanning
questions.stem: Why should a handover barcode be scaled to a minimum readable size?
